# Gate Requirements Checklist: CI builds what ships

**Purpose**: Validate the quality of the requirements for building and packaging the published bundle on every pull request — completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability and coverage — before any code is written.
**Created**: 2026-11-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is the claim that CI never builds the shipped bundle stated as measurement rather than inference? [Completeness, Spec § Overview] — five measurements on `develop@d20f31d`: the gate's six steps, `build` carrying no `--production`, `vsce ls` producing no esbuild output, the four bundle sizes, and the release workflow's `build_command`.
- [x] CHK002 Is it established that `vsce ls` does not run `vscode:prepublish`, rather than assumed? [Completeness, Spec § Overview] — run this pass; it printed the file list and no build output.
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements stated for the packaging step as well as the build? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003] — FR-003, because a tree that builds can still fail to package.
- [x] CHK004 Is a requirement stated for running the same check locally, not only in CI? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006] — FR-006, one named script.
- [x] CHK005 Are the documents that must change enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007] — `docs/testing.md`, `docs/releasing.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, with the byte budget named.
- [x] CHK006 Is the ordering question raised as a requirement rather than left to the implementer's taste? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004] — FR-004 requires the choice be stated and justified; the plan makes it and gives the trade-off.

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is "the same mode the published `.vsix` carries" specific enough to be satisfied only one way? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001] — it names the mode by its effect, and the plan ties it to `esbuild.mjs --production`, the literal `vscode:prepublish` runs.
- [x] CHK008 Is it clear which bundle `assertSelfContained` must run against? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002] — the production one, and FR-002 states the discriminating case: a pull request must fail where the dev bundle would not.
- [x] CHK009 Is the reason minification changes the guard's verdict stated, rather than asserted? [Clarity, Spec § Overview] — the guard matches `"./…"` string literals, and minification renames, hoists and re-splits strings.
- [x] CHK010 Is it clear that nothing is broken today, so a reader does not go looking for a live bug? [Clarity, Spec § Overview] — stated plainly: the production build passes the guard on this tree, checked this pass; the defect is the absence of a check.

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Does FR-003's packaging requirement conflict with FR-001's build requirement, given `vsce package` rebuilds production itself? [Conflict, Spec §FR-001, §FR-003] — no, and the plan says why the apparent redundancy is deliberate: FR-003 is about the packaging step, and the second build costs under a second.
- [x] CHK012 Do the spec and plan agree on where the gate's chain lives? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Plan § Surfaces touched] — both say `build-check.yml`'s `run:` input, this repo's own, and both say the reusable workflow is not touched.
- [x] CHK013 Are the bundle sizes stated consistently wherever they appear? [Consistency] — 418.7 KB / 1.4 MB dev against 207.0 KB / 299.0 KB production, in the overview, the out-of-scope note and T002.
- [x] CHK014 Does the out-of-scope note about the 1.4 MB dev webview contradict the overview, which cites it as evidence? [Consistency, Spec § Overview, § Out of scope] — no: the overview cites it to show the two builds differ; the out-of-scope note declines to _retune_ it, and says the shipped number is 299 KB.

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK015 Is exactly one success criterion marked as the runnable line, and does it fail today? [Measurability, Spec § Success criteria] — one, run this pass: `npm run build:production` exits 1, `Missing script`.
- [x] CHK016 Is the central criterion — a failure the dev build would not catch — expressed as something to demonstrate rather than claim? [Measurability, Spec § Success criteria, Tasks §T011] — the criterion asks for what was broken, the failure and the revert.
- [x] CHK017 Does the spec say what to do if that demonstration cannot be constructed, so the criterion cannot be quietly ticked? [Gap, Spec § Success criteria, Tasks §T012] — T012 covers it: say so, do not tick, and treat it as a finding about the guard rather than a reason to widen its regex.
- [x] CHK018 Is the ordering decision checkable, given it is a judgment? [Measurability, Spec § Success criteria] — the criterion requires naming which build is on disk for `test:integration` and why, which is a statement a reviewer can agree or disagree with.
- [x] CHK019 Is the cost criterion measured rather than estimated? [Measurability, Spec § Success criteria, Tasks §T022] — both criterion and task require the job's own duration before and after, and whether it crosses a billed-minute boundary.
- [x] CHK020 Is the required-check criterion stated as a fact to confirm rather than a hope? [Measurability, Spec § Success criteria, §FR-005] — the `build` job keeps its name, confirmed and said in the pull request.

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK021 Are requirements defined for the contributor whose dependency change would break only the minified bundle? [Coverage, Spec § User scenarios, §FR-002] — scenario 1, which is the whole point.
- [x] CHK022 Are requirements defined for whoever merges the release pull request? [Coverage, Spec § User scenarios] — scenario 2: the production build is already green on that tree.
- [x] CHK023 Are requirements defined for running the production check locally? [Coverage, Spec § User scenarios, §FR-006] — scenario 3.
- [x] CHK024 Is the integration suite's relationship to `dist/` addressed, since it is the one place the layers run together? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004, Plan § Technical context] — FR-004 raises it and the plan decides it, with the trade-off named.

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK025 Does the spec say what happens to the `.vsix` the gate builds? [Gap, Edge Case, Plan § Technical context, Tasks §T009] — built and discarded, nothing uploaded, and T009 confirms `.gitignore` covers it so a local run leaves nothing behind.
- [x] CHK026 Is the case covered where the packaged file set changes because of this? [Coverage, Plan § Surfaces touched, Tasks §T010] — T010, and `test/ci/package-contents.test.ts` already runs in the gate as the check.
- [x] CHK027 Is the case covered where someone later changes one production entry point and not the other? [Gap, Plan § Technical context, Tasks §T005] — the pin test, which is the same class of gap this ticket closes, and T006 proves it bites.
- [x] CHK028 Does the spec bound itself against retuning the production build while it is in there? [Coverage, Spec § Out of scope] — `minify` and the dropped sourcemap stay exactly as they are.

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK029 Is the added CI time treated as spend to justify rather than a rounding error? [Completeness, Plan § Surfaces touched, Tasks §T022] — the plan says billed minutes round up per job and refuses to estimate; T022 reads the job.
- [x] CHK030 Is the required-check name addressed, so no branch ruleset edit is owed? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005] — FR-005 and T014: the `build` job is not renamed and no job is added or removed.
- [x] CHK031 Is the published surface addressed, given this is a released extension? [Coverage, Plan § Surfaces touched] — `contributes`, the commands and the schema are untouched, and the packaged contents are held by an existing test.

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK032 Is it stated that no dependency is added? [Dependency, Plan § Surfaces touched] — the surfaces list changes `package.json` only for a script; `vsce` is already how `package` runs.
- [x] CHK033 Is the assumption that `vsce package` re-runs `vscode:prepublish` stated rather than relied on silently? [Assumption, Plan § Technical context] — stated, and it is why `package` after `build:production` is not redundant.
- [x] CHK034 Is the assumption documented that `esbuild.mjs` itself needs no change? [Assumption, Plan § Surfaces touched, Tasks §T016] — "no change expected", with T016 and T012 covering the case where the guard turns out to be blind.

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK035 Is it unambiguous whether the gate's new steps run before or after the integration suite? [Ambiguity, Plan § Technical context, Tasks §T007] — after, with the reason and the rejected alternative both written down.
- [ ] CHK036 Does the spec resolve whether the ordering decision deserves an ADR? [Ambiguity, Plan § Surfaces touched, Tasks §T023] — **left open, deliberately.** The plan says an ADR is plausible and hands the call to the build, with T023 requiring an answer either way in the pull request. Open because the judgment belongs to whoever sees the choice hold up in review, not to grooming — and leaving it open is what keeps T023 from being skipped.

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
